items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
items.claim: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai

items.quote: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
items.claim: Male children of Levi from one month old and upward were to be numbered by families and ancestral houses
items.object: the children of Levi (every male from a month old and upward)
